name: Greater Stench (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Stench, Ability Focus (stench), Improved Stench, Con 13

Benefit(s): Even creatures who successfully save against your stench gain the sickened condition for 1 round, but after this duration are immune to the effect of your stench ability for 24 hours.
